sections.notes: Melancholic grand piano solo over rain sound; acoustic guitar strumming enters slowly. Establishes the wet-grey aftermath. CINEMATIC: character absent or tiny in frame — Architecture Cage, the storm already passed.

sections.lyrics: I calculated the orbits... of a billion stars. / I could have mapped the infinite with this processor. / These hands were designed to grasp the future, / To hold tomorrow like certainty. / I used to raise them to the sky, clenched in triumph. / But now... / They are hiding inside empty pockets. / Curled into a fist of shame.
sections.notes: Minimalist grand piano, sad and slow. Deep, calm, melancholic spoken word. The fall from arrogance — hands once raised in triumph now hidden in shame. CINEMATIC: hands motif; reflection of damaged self in a wet surface.
Piano solo, slow & sad. INDIFFERENT FLOW interlude — character absent, only the wet-grey world. Architecture Cage pure.

sections.lyrics: They coded a lie into my system: / "November is for lovers." / A soft, romantic script... / a warm deception. / Love is installed. / Poetry is updated. / But there is no line of code for "Hunger"... / Not a single byte.
sections.notes: Heavy bass note enters, darker tone. Bitter, cynical spoken word. The programmed romance vs. the unprogrammed hunger. November = cold, wet month.
Brief piano sting / breath. Transition into the disgust of Verse 2.5.

sections.lyrics: This gray air... / is deeper than my alloy skin. / A dampness so heavy, / it makes the chassis gag. / It makes the metal want to vomit its own rust.
sections.notes: Music rising. Disgusted whisper. KEY: the wet-grey motif is literally in the lyrics here — gray air, dampness, rust. This section anchors the binding atmosphere. Rising unease, not yet release.

sections.lyrics: Just to silence the screams in my brain... / I dive into the noise... into the data stream.
sections.notes: Chaotic sounds in the background, no beat. Melancholic spoken word. He drowns the inner silence in the world's noise — sets up the first refrain.

sections.lyrics: Billions of users... / Here. / But you... are NOT.
sections.notes: REFRAIN 1 of 5. Emotional / high-pitch singing. The absent 'you' = the Mentor. CINEMATIC: Retreating Camera — first refrain, camera begins its progressive distancing. Dolly Out.
Piano solo, slow & sad. INDIFFERENT FLOW interlude — character absent, world flows past the empty space.

sections.lyrics: Doing nothing... costs so much energy. / I refresh the inbox... / "Maybe this time." / Refresh... Refresh... Refresh... / "Do Not Reply." / "Application Rejected." / Everyone is sorry... / No one is hiring.
sections.notes: Spoken word over a ticking-clock rhythm. The Routine — unemployment, refreshing, rejection. Relatable-dark modern human condition. CINEMATIC: cold screen-glow (false light), Chrome Reflection in a dead/dark screen.

sections.lyrics: Rejection emails... / Here. / But you... are NOT.
sections.notes: REFRAIN 2 of 5. Emotional / high-pitch singing. CINEMATIC: Retreating Camera — camera MORE distant than refrain 1. Dolly Out, wider.
Piano solo, slow & sad. INDIFFERENT FLOW interlude — wet-grey world, character absent.

sections.lyrics: My receiver... playing deaf and mute... / Suddenly starts chirping like birds announcing spring. / I open the line with a spark of hope. / Then, that cold, synthetic voice: / "Your payment is past due...." / Lying in ambush like crocodiles... / They hunt this metal deer / at the worst possible time.
sections.notes: Melancholic spoken word over fuzz guitar. The Predator — a 3-second silence falls before the creditor's cold synthetic voice ('Your payment is past due'). Hope chirps, then is hunted. Honor the silence with a held visual beat.

sections.lyrics: Creditors... / Here. / But you... are NOT.
sections.notes: REFRAIN 3 of 5. Emotional / high-pitch singing. CINEMATIC: Retreating Camera — even more distant. Dolly Out.
Brief melancholic piano solo. Short INDIFFERENT FLOW breath before the Vanity verse.

sections.lyrics: Just to have an excuse to leave the house... / I go to that / "Glittering Avenue."
sections.notes: Deep spoken word. The Vanity — the 'Glittering Avenue' (the cold, screen-lit consumer street). CINEMATIC: thousands of indifferent faces, Robotiko tiny among them. Architecture Cage at its widest crowd.

sections.lyrics: Thousands of faces... / Here. / But you... are NOT.
sections.notes: REFRAIN 4 of 5. Emotional / high-pitch singing. CINEMATIC: Retreating Camera — most distant yet before the final refrain. Dolly Out, widest crowd.
Piano solo, slow & sad. INDIFFERENT FLOW interlude before the angry corruption verse.

sections.lyrics: Hoping the minutes that pass like days might speed up... / I turn on the broadcast. / System Lords..... / wiping blood from their hands / while accepting peace awards... / Fake heroes on the screen... / Fake victories.
sections.notes: Angry spoken word, building. The Corruption — a 3-second silence falls after 'peace awards'. The broadcast = false light. System Lords echo EP02's hypocrisy. Honor the silence with a held beat.

sections.lyrics: The Fake Truth... / Here. / But You... Are NOT.
sections.notes: REFRAIN 5 of 5 — the final and most distant. Emotional / high-pitch singing. CINEMATIC: Retreating Camera at its farthest. The pattern is now fully established — about to be broken at the climax.

sections.lyrics: Because you are gone........! / Where is that amber gaze? / Where is the slap to strike the face of this gray?... / Where is the fist to pierce through this fog?...
sections.notes: EMOTIONAL PEAK. Emotional / high-pitch singing. The lyrics name our entire palette: 'amber gaze' (the absent Mentor / absent warmth), 'this gray' (wet-grey motif), 'this fog'. The cry of the Dark Night. STILL HOLD candidate at its summit.

Emotional fuzz guitar solo crying out high notes. The distortion slowly fades to feedback, then transitions to silence. The cathartic release before the turn. CINEMATIC: this is the long art-film breath — wet-grey world, character absent or distant, then the world drains to silence.

sections.lyrics: Now I remember... / You spoke of a "Wasteland." / Now I understand... / I have been searching for the wrong things. / I must cast off this metal straightjacket... / And get out of here.
sections.notes: THE AWAKENING. Sudden silence, then minimalist grand piano, slow. Deep, calm, HOPEFUL spoken word — the first hope of the episode. The Mentor's Wasteland teaching surfaces from memory. The decision forms. Tone shift: desolation begins to lift.

sections.lyrics: To forget what I was taught. / To remember what I forgot. / The Hammer of Truth is there. / You are there. / I know... / I AM COMING.
sections.notes: THE CLIMAX. Whispered mantra building to powerful, certain declaration. 'Hammer of Truth' = EP04 callback. THE SINGLE AMBER MOMENT of the entire episode lands here — one warm glint at 'I AM COMING'. CINEMATIC: the first and ONLY Dolly In of the episode — the Retreating Camera pattern is broken. Will asserted.

FINAL JOURNEY. A soulful, melodic fuzz guitar solo over grand piano — hopeful but melancholic. Music slowly fades into the sound of wind howling, then fade out. CINEMATIC: the first forward motion of the episode; the wasteland/horizon opens. Sets up EP08's mountain ascent.
